### Brief Solutions

- **[id 60]**: Unripe oranges = $0.20 \times 25 = 5$. Good oranges = $25 - (1 + 5 + 2) = 17$.
- **[id 61]**: Base cost = $\$500 + \$800 = \$1300$. Insurance = $10\% \text{ of } \$1300 = \$130$. Total = $\$1300 + \$130 = 1430$.
- **[id 62]**: Years entitled = $30 - 20 = 10$ years. Pension percentage = $10 \times 5\% = 50\%$. Annual pension = $0.50 \times \$50,000 = 25000$.
- **[id 63]**: First 6 months = $6 \times \$140 = \$840$. Last 6 months = $6 \times (\$140 \times 0.90) = 6 \times \$126 = \$756$. Total = $\$840 + \$756 = 1596$.
- **[id 64]**: Fuel economy = $100 \text{ miles} / 4 \text{ gallons} = 25 \text{ mpg}$. Range = $12 \times 25 = 300$.
- **[id 65]**: Daily time = $2 + 1 = 3$ hours. Total hours in 4 weeks = $3 \text{ hours/day} \times 3 \text{ days/week} \times 4 \text{ weeks} = 36$.
- **[id 66]**: Per school = $2 \text{ teams} \times 5 \text{ players} + 2 \text{ coaches} = 12$ people. Total for 4 schools = $4 \times 12 = 48$.
- **[id 67]**: Diamonds = $175$. Rubies = $175 - 35 = 140$. Emeralds = $2 \times 140 = 280$. Total = $175 + 140 + 280 = 595$.
- **[id 68]**: Girls = $60$, Boys = $120$. Total students = $180$. Teachers = $180 / 5 = 36$.
- **[id 69]**: Allowance earned = $8 \times \$5 = \$40$. Starting amount = $\$100 - \$40 = 60$.
